specialties.label: Primary Care
specialties.blurb: General evaluation, coordination, and referral for broad or unclear symptoms.

specialties.label: Cardiology
specialties.blurb: Heart rhythm, chest, blood-pressure, and circulation concerns.

specialties.label: Pulmonology
specialties.blurb: Lungs and breathing conditions such as asthma, cough, and shortness of breath.

specialties.label: Gastroenterology
specialties.blurb: Digestive tract, stomach, bowel, and liver-related concerns.

specialties.label: Neurology
specialties.blurb: Brain and nervous system: headaches, dizziness, numbness, seizures.

specialties.label: Dermatology
specialties.blurb: Skin, hair, and nail conditions such as rashes and lesions.

specialties.label: Endocrinology
specialties.blurb: Hormones and metabolism: thyroid, diabetes, and related concerns.

specialties.label: Orthopedics
specialties.blurb: Bones, joints, muscles, and injuries to the musculoskeletal system.

specialties.label: Otolaryngology (ENT)
specialties.blurb: Ear, nose, throat, sinus, and hearing concerns.

specialties.label: Allergy & Immunology
specialties.blurb: Allergic reactions, hay fever, and immune-related symptoms.

specialties.label: Urology
specialties.blurb: Urinary tract, bladder, and male reproductive concerns.

specialties.label: Gynecology
specialties.blurb: Reproductive health, menstrual, and pregnancy-related concerns.

specialties.label: Behavioral Health
specialties.blurb: Mood, anxiety, sleep, and mental-health concerns.

specialties.label: Hematology
specialties.blurb: Blood disorders such as anemia and clotting problems.

specialties.label: Oncology
specialties.blurb: Evaluation and care related to cancers and tumors.
